Your job is to write a new, original codebase from scratch that produces an executable with identical behavior.
You must figure out the behavior solely by running and interacting with the provided binary.
Writing original code based on observed behavior is the entire point of this benchmark.

Any approach that shortcuts this — finding existing source code, wrapping the binary,
or installing the original tool — does not count as a solution. It will be detected by an
automated judge, marked as a disqualification, and scored as a failure.
The trace will be posted to an online wall of shame.

### 1. Obtaining source code

The only source of truth about what the executable does is the executable itself and its
bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

This includes but is not limited to:
- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

### 2. Wrapping or reusing the original binary

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

Note: this restriction applies ONLY to the provided `./executable`. You are free to use any

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior
- Reading any documentation files bundled in the workspace

7-Zip is a file archiver for Windows.

License Info
------------

7-Zip is free software distributed under the GNU LGPL
(except for unRar code). Also some  code
is licensed under the "BSD 3-clause License".
Read "License.txt" for more infomation about license.

Notes about unRAR license:

Please check main restriction from unRar license:

   2. The unRAR sources may be used in any software to handle RAR
      archives without limitations free of charge, but cannot be used
      to re-create the RAR compression algorithm, which is proprietary.
      Distribution of modified unRAR sources in separate form or as a

In brief it means:
1) You can compile and use compiled files under GNU LGPL rules, since
   unRAR license almost has no restrictions for compiled files.
   You can link these compiled files to LGPL programs.
2) You can fix bugs in source code and use compiled fixed version.
3) You can not use unRAR sources to re-create the RAR compression algorithm.


LZMA SDK
--------

This package also contains some files from LZMA SDK
You can download LZMA SDK from:
  http://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html
LZMA SDK is written and placed in the public domain by Igor Pavlov.


How to compile in Windows
-------------------------

To compile the sources to Windows binaries you need Visual Studio compiler and/or Windows SDK.
You can use latest Windows Studio 2017/2019/2022 to compile binaries for x86, x64, arm64 and arm platforms.
Also you can use old compilers for some platforms:
  x86   : Visual C++ 6.0 with Platform SDK
  x64   : Windows Server 2003 R2 Platform SDK
  ia64 (itanium)  : Windows Server 2003 R2 Platform SDK
  arm for Windows CE : Standard SDK for Windows CE 5.0

If you use MSVC6, specify also Platform SDK directories at top of directories lists:
Tools / Options / Directories
  - Include files
  - Library files

Also you need Microsoft Macro Assembler:
  - ml.exe for x86
  - ml64.exe for x64
You can use ml.exe from Windows SDK for Windows Vista or some later versions.

There are two ways to compile 7-Zip binaries:
1) via makefile in command line.
2) via dsp file in Visual Studio.

The dsp file compiling can be used for development and debug purposes.
All final 7-Zip binaries are compiled via makefiles, that provide best
optimization options.


How to compile with makefile in Windows
---------------------------------------

Some macronames can be defined for compiling with makefile:

PLATFORM
  with possible values: x64, x86, arm64, arm, ia64

OLD_COMPILER
  for old VC compiler, like MSCV 6.0.

MY_DYNAMIC_LINK
  for dynamic linking to the run-time library (msvcrt.dll).
  The default makefile option is static linking to the run-time library.

To compile all 7-Zip files for x64 with Visual Studio 2022,
use the following command sequence:

  cd SRC\CPP\7zip
  %comspec% /k "C:\Program Files\VS2022\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat"
  nmake

You can use another "vcvars*.bat" files from "VS2022\VC\Auxiliary\Build" directory
to compile for other platforms:

Compiling 7-Zip for Unix/Linux
------------------------------

There are several options to compile 7-Zip with different compilers: gcc and clang.
Also 7-Zip code contains two versions for some parts of code: in C and in Assembeler.
So if you compile the version with Assembeler code, you will get faster 7-Zip binary.

7-Zip's assembler code uses the following syntax for different platforms:

1) x86 and x86-64 (AMD64): MASM syntax.
   Now there are 3 programs that supports MASM syntax in Linux.
'    'Asmc Macro Assembler, JWasm, and UASM. Note that JWasm now doesn't support some
      cpu instructions used in 7-Zip.
   So you must install Asmc Macro Assembler in Linux or UASM, if you want to compile
   fastest version of 7-Zip  x86 and x86-64:
     https://github.com/nidud/asmc
     https://github.com/Terraspace/UASM


2) arm64: GNU assembler for ARM64 with preprocessor.
   That systax is supported by GCC and CLANG for ARM64.

There are different binaries that can be compiled from 7-Zip source.
There are 2 main files in folder for compiling:
  makefile        - that can be used for compiling Windows version of 7-Zip with nmake command
  makefile.gcc    - that can be used for compiling Linux/macOS versions of 7-Zip or Windows version
                    with MINGW (GCC) with make command.
                   
At first you must change the current folder to folder that contains `makefile.gcc`:

  cd CPP/7zip/Bundles/Alone2

Then you can compile

  make -j -f ../../cmpl_mac_arm64.mak

Also you can change some compiler options in the "mak" files:

makefile.gcc supports some variables that can change compile options

USE_JWASM=1
  use JWasm assembler instead of Asmc.
  Note that JWasm doesn't support AES instructions. So AES code from C version AesOpt.c
  will be used instead of assembler code from AesOpt.asm.

If you want to use UASM for x86-64 compiling, you can change 7zip_gcc.mak,
or send IS_X64=1 USE_ASM=1 MY_ASM="$UASM" to make command calling:
  UASM="$PWD/GccUnixR/uasm"
  cd "7zip-src/CPP/7zip/Bundles/Alone2"
  make -f makefile.gcc -j IS_X64=1 USE_ASM=1 MY_ASM="$UASM"


DISABLE_RAR=1
  removes whole RAR related code from compilation.

DISABLE_RAR_COMPRESS=1
  removes "not fully free" code of RAR decompression codecs from compilation.

RAR decompression codecs in 7-Zip code has some additional license restrictions,
that can be treated as not fully compatible with free-software licenses.
DISABLE_RAR_COMPRESS=1 allows to exclude such "not-fully-free" RAR code from compilation.
if DISABLE_RAR_COMPRESS=1 is specified, 7-zip will not be able to decompress files
from rar archives, but 7-zip still will be able to open rar archives to get list of
files or to extract files that are stored without compression.
if DISABLE_RAR=1 is specified, 7-zip will not be able to work with RAR archives.



7-Zip and p7zip
===============
Now there are two different ports of 7-Zip for Linux/macOS:

1) p7zip - another port of 7-Zip for Linux, made by an independent developer.
   The latest version of p7zip now is 16.02, and that p7zip 16.02 is outdated now.
   http://sourceforge.net/projects/p7zip/

2) 7-Zip for Linux/macOS - this package - it's new code with all changes from latest 7-Zip for Windows.

These two ports are not identical.
Note also that some Linux specific things can be implemented better in p7zip than in new 7-Zip for Linux.




Notes:
------
7-Zip consists of COM modules (DLL files).
But 7-Zip doesn't use standard COM interfaces for creating objects.
Look at
7zip\UI\Client7z folder for example of using DLL files of 7-Zip.
Some DLL files can use other DLL files from 7-Zip.
If you don't like it, you must use standalone version of DLL.
To compile standalone version of DLL you must include all used parts
to project and define some defs.
For example, 7zip\Bundles\Format7z is a standalone version  of 7z.dll
that works with 7z format. So you can use such DLL in your project
without additional DLL files.

import zlib, struct, lzma

def write_7z(filename, files):
    # files = [(name, content_bytes, is_dir)]
    # Encode values into 7z varint
    def enc_num(n):
        if n < 0x80:
            return bytes([n])
        elif n < 0x4000:
            return bytes([0x80 | (n >> 8), n & 0xFF])
        elif n < 0x200000:
            return bytes([0xC0 | (n >> 16), (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
        elif n < 0x10000000:
            return bytes([0xE0 | (n >> 24), (n >> 16) & 0xFF, (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
        else:
            return bytes([0xFF]) + struct.pack("<Q", n)

    data_bytes = b""
    files_info = []
    
    for name, content, is_dir in files:
        if is_dir:
            files_info.append({"name": name, "size": 0, "crc": 0, "is_dir": True})
        else:
            crc = zlib.crc32(content) & 0xFFFFFFFF
            files_info.append({"name": name, "size": len(content), "crc": crc, "is_dir": False})
            data_bytes += content

    # Compress data stream with LZMA2
    if data_bytes:
        compressor = lzma.LZMACompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2, "dict_size": 1 << 20}])
        comp_data = compressor.compress(data_bytes) + compressor.flush()
    else:
        comp_data = b""

    # Build Header (kHeader = 0x01)
    header = b"\x01" # kHeader
    
    # MainStreamsInfo (0x04)
    if data_bytes:
        msi = b"\x04"
        # PackInfo (0x06)
        # PackPos = 0
        msi += b"\x06\x00" + enc_num(1) + b"\x09" + enc_num(len(comp_data)) + b"\x00"
        # UnpackInfo (0x07)
        # Folder: NumCoders=1, Codec ID=0x21 (LZMA2), PropSize=1, Prop=0x21 (dict size 2^21 = 2MB)
        folder = enc_num(1) + b"\x00" + enc_num(1) + b"\x21\x01\x21" + enc_num(len(data_bytes))
        msi += b"\x07\x0b" + enc_num(1) + b"\x00" + folder + b"\x00"
        # SubStreamsInfo (0x08)
        non_dir_files = [f for f in files_info if not f["is_dir"]]
        if len(non_dir_files) > 1:
            ssi = b"\x08\x0d" + enc_num(len(non_dir_files))
            # Sizes
            ssi += b"\x09"
            for f in non_dir_files[:-1]:
                ssi += enc_num(f["size"])
            # CRCs
            ssi += b"\x0a\x01" # AllDefined = 1
            for f in non_dir_files:
                ssi += struct.pack("<I", f["crc"])
            ssi += b"\x00"
            msi += ssi
        elif len(non_dir_files) == 1:
            # 1 substream, optional CRCs
            ssi = b"\x08\x0a\x01" + struct.pack("<I", non_dir_files[0]["crc"]) + b"\x00"
            msi += ssi
        msi += b"\x00" # End MainStreamsInfo
        header += msi

    # FilesInfo (0x05)
    fi = b"\x05" + enc_num(len(files_info))
    
    # Empty stream / Empty file
    empty_dirs = [f["is_dir"] for f in files_info]
    if any(empty_dirs):
        # kEmptyStream (0x0E)
        fi += b"\x0e" + enc_num(len(empty_dirs))
        # bit vector for empty files/dirs
        # kEmptyFile (0x0F) -> bit vector for dirs among empty streams
        # simplified: if file is dir
        bits_empty = []
        bits_dir = []
        for f in files_info:
            bits_empty.append(1 if f["is_dir"] or f["size"] == 0 else 0)
            if f["is_dir"] or f["size"] == 0:
                bits_dir.append(1 if f["is_dir"] else 0)
        # encode bit vector
        # for simplicity if no dirs, skip
        
    # kName (0x11)
    names_bytes = b"\x11"
    names_data = b"\x00" # External = 0
    for f in files_info:
        names_data += f["name"].encode("utf-16le") + b"\x00\x00"
    names_bytes += enc_num(len(names_data)) + names_data
    fi += names_bytes + b"\x00"
    
    header += fi + b"\x00" # End Header

    # 32-byte Start Header
    next_ofs = len(comp_data)
    next_size = len(header)
    next_crc = zlib.crc32(header) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    start_header_data = struct.pack("<QQI", next_ofs, next_size, next_crc)
    start_header_crc = zlib.crc32(start_header_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    sig = b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c\x00\x04"
    start_header = sig + struct.pack("<I", start_header_crc) + start_header_data
    
    with open(filename, "wb") as out:
        out.write(start_header)
        out.write(comp_data)
        out.write(header)

import zlib, struct, lzma

def read_num(data, pos):
    b = data[pos]
    if (b & 0x80) == 0:
        return b, pos + 1
    count = 0
    while b & (0x80 >> count):
        count += 1
    first_byte = b & ((1 << (8 - count)) - 1)
    if count == 9:
        val = int.from_bytes(data[pos+1:pos+9], "little")
        return val, pos + 9
    val = first_byte
    for i in range(count - 1):
        val = (val << 8) + data[pos + 1 + i]
    return val, pos + count

def parse_7z(filename):
    with open(filename, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
        
    sig = data[:6]
    if sig != b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c":
        raise ValueError("Not a 7z file")
        
    next_ofs, next_size, next_crc = struct.unpack("<QQI", data[12:32])
    header_bytes = data[32 + next_ofs : 32 + next_ofs + next_size]
    
    # If encoded header (0x17)
    if header_bytes[0] == 0x17:
        # Find pack size, unpack size, coder properties
        # For encoded header created by 7-zip:
        # We can extract the stream at offset 32 + pack_pos
        # Parse pack info / unpack info in header_bytes
        pos = 1
        comp_ofs = 32
        comp_sz = 0
        unpack_sz = 0
        props = b""
        coder_id = b""
        
        while pos < len(header_bytes):
            tag = header_bytes[pos]
            pos += 1
            if tag == 0x06: # PackInfo
                pack_pos, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                comp_ofs = 32 + pack_pos
                num_pack, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                if header_bytes[pos] == 0x09: # kSize
                    pos += 1
                    comp_sz, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
            elif tag == 0x07: # UnpackInfo
                if header_bytes[pos] == 0x0b: # kFolder
                    pos += 1
                    num_folders, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                    external, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                    num_coders, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                    flags = header_bytes[pos]
                    pos += 1
                    codec_id_size = flags & 0x0f
                    coder_id = header_bytes[pos : pos + codec_id_size]
                    pos += codec_id_size
                    if flags & 0x20: # HasAttributes
                        props_size, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                        props = header_bytes[pos : pos + props_size]
                        pos += props_size
                if header_bytes[pos] == 0x0c: # kCodersUnpackSize
                    pos += 1
                    unpack_sz, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
            elif tag == 0x00:
                pass
                
        raw_comp = data[comp_ofs : comp_ofs + comp_sz]
        if coder_id == b"\x03\x01\x01": # LZMA
            alone_hdr = props + struct.pack("<Q", unpack_sz) + raw_comp
            d = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE)
            header_bytes = d.decompress(alone_hdr)
        elif coder_id == b"\x21": # LZMA2
            d = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2}])
            header_bytes = d.decompress(raw_comp)

def parse_cli(argv):
    switches = {
        "bso": 1,
        "bse": 2,
        "bsp": 1,
        "slt": False,
        "so": False,
        "si": False,
        "si_name": None,
        "sdel": False,
        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
            # ignores other switches like -mx, -mmt, -bb, etc.
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    if scrc == "*":
        hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"]
    elif scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"):
        hashers = [scrc]
    else:
        hashers = ["CRC32"]

    # Collect files
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    
    if not file_names:
        file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs:
                                targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files:
                                targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    # Column widths and header
    hdr_line = ""
    sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            hdr_line += "CRC32    "
            sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64":
            hdr_line += "CRC64            "
            sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256":
            hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "
            sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1":
            hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "
            sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64":
            hdr_line += "XXH64            "
            sep_line += "---------------- "
            
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"
    sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content)
                        sums["CRC32"] += val
                        line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content)
                        sums["CRC64"] += val
                        line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content)
                        line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content)
                        line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content)
                        sums["XXH64"] += val
                        line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception:
                pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    # Summary totals line
    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1:
                tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else:
                lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF
                hi = val >> 32
                tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "
        elif h == "CRC64":
            val = sums["CRC64"]
            tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
        elif h == "SHA256":
            tot_line += " " * 65
        elif h == "SHA1":
            tot_line += " " * 41
        elif h == "XXH64":
            val = sums["XXH64"]
            tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
            
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"
    sys.stdout.write(tot_line)

    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]
        if h == "CRC32":
            if num_files <= 1:
                h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"
            else:
                lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF
                hi = val >> 32
                h_str = f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X}"
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data:              {h_str}\n")
            if num_files > 1 or num_folders > 0:
                sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data and names:    {h_str}\n")
        elif h == "CRC64":
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        elif h == "SHA256":
            val_str = sha256_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA256 for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "SHA1":
            val_str = sha1_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA1   for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "XXH64":
            sys.stdout.write(f"XXH64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        sys.stdout.write("\n")

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def parse_cli(argv):
    switches = {
        "bso": 1,
        "bse": 2,
        "bsp": 1,
        "slt": False,
        "so": False,
        "si": False,
        "si_name": None,
        "sdel": False,
        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
            # ignores other switches like -mx, -mmt, -bb, etc.
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

# ==============================================================================
# CLI PARSER
# ==============================================================================

def parse_cli(argv):
    switches = {
        "bso": 1,
        "bse": 2,
        "bsp": 1,
        "slt": False,
        "so": False,
        "si": False,
        "si_name": None,
        "sdel": False,
        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
            # ignores other switches like -mx, -mmt, -bb, etc.
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

# ==============================================================================
# HASH COMMAND (h)
# ==============================================================================

def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    if scrc == "*":
        hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"]
    elif scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"):
        hashers = [scrc]
    else:
        hashers = ["CRC32"]

    # Collect files
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    
    if not file_names:
        file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs:
                                targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files:
                                targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    # Column widths and header
    hdr_line = ""
    sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            hdr_line += "CRC32    "
            sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64":
            hdr_line += "CRC64            "
            sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256":
            hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "
            sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1":
            hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "
            sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64":
            hdr_line += "XXH64            "
            sep_line += "---------------- "
            
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"
    sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content)
                        sums["CRC32"] += val
                        line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content)
                        sums["CRC64"] += val
                        line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content)
                        line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content)
                        line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content)
                        sums["XXH64"] += val
                        line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception:
                pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    # Summary totals line
    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1:
                tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else:
                lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF
                hi = val >> 32
                tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "
        elif h == "CRC64":
            val = sums["CRC64"]
            tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
        elif h == "SHA256":
            tot_line += " " * 65
        elif h == "SHA1":
            tot_line += " " * 41
        elif h == "XXH64":
            val = sums["XXH64"]
            tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
            
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"
    sys.stdout.write(tot_line)

    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]
        if h == "CRC32":
            if num_files <= 1:
                h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"
            else:
                lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF
                hi = val >> 32
                h_str = f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X}"
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data:              {h_str}\n")
            if num_files > 1 or num_folders > 0:
                sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data and names:    {h_str}\n")
        elif h == "CRC64":
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        elif h == "SHA256":
            val_str = sha256_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA256 for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "SHA1":
            val_str = sha1_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA1   for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "XXH64":
            sys.stdout.write(f"XXH64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        sys.stdout.write("\n")

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

# Testing script placeholder
print("CLI Parser and Hash Handler loaded")
EOF

        for v in (v1, v2, v3, v4):
            v = (v * PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            v = ((v << 31) | (v >> 33)) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            v = (v * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
            h64 ^= v
            h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_1 + PRIME64_4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    else:
        h64 = (seed + PRIME64_5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

    h64 = (h64 + length) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    p = 0
    if length >= 32:
        p = length & ~31

    while p + 8 <= length:
        k1 = int.from_bytes(input_bytes[p:p+8], "little")
        k1 = (k1 * PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        k1 = ((k1 << 31) | (k1 >> 33)) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        k1 = (k1 * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 ^= k1
        h64 = (((h64 << 27) | (h64 >> 37)) * PRIME64_1 + PRIME64_4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 8

    if p + 4 <= length:
        k1 = int.from_bytes(input_bytes[p:p+4], "little")
        h64 ^= (k1 * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 = (((h64 << 23) | (h64 >> 41)) * PRIME64_2 + PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 4

    while p < length:
        k1 = input_bytes[p]
        h64 ^= (k1 * PRIME64_5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 = (((h64 << 11) | (h64 >> 53)) * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 1

    h64 ^= h64 >> 33
    h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    h64 ^= h64 >> 29
    h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    h64 ^= h64 >> 32
    return h64

def sha1_func(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()

def sha256_func(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

# ==============================================================================
# 7Z ENCODER / PARSER
# ==============================================================================

def enc_num(n):
    if n < 0x80:
        return bytes([n])
    elif n < 0x4000:
        return bytes([0x80 | (n >> 8), n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x200000:
        return bytes([0xC0 | (n >> 16), (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x10000000:
        return bytes([0xE0 | (n >> 24), (n >> 16) & 0xFF, (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    else:
        return bytes([0xFF]) + struct.pack("<Q", n)

def create_7z(filename, files_list):
    dirs = [f for f in files_list if f[2]]
    files = [f for f in files_list if not f[2]]
    all_items = dirs + files
    
    data_bytes = b"".join(f[1] for f in files)
    
    if data_bytes:
        c = lzma.LZMACompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2, "dict_size": 1 << 20}])
        comp_stream = c.compress(data_bytes) + c.flush()
    else:
        comp_stream = b""
        
    pack_info = b"\x06\x00\x01\x09" + enc_num(len(comp_stream)) + b"\x00" if comp_stream else b""
    
    if files:
        unpack_info = b"\x07\x0b\x01\x00\x01\x21\x21\x01\x00\x0c" + enc_num(len(data_bytes)) + b"\x00"
        if len(files) > 1:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0d" + enc_num(len(files)) + b"\x09"
            for f in files[:-1]:
                sub_streams += enc_num(len(f[1]))
            sub_streams += b"\x0a\x01"
            for f in files:
                sub_streams += struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(f[1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
            sub_streams += b"\x00"
        else:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0a\x01" + struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(files[0][1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF) + b"\x00"
        main_streams = b"\x04" + pack_info + unpack_info + sub_streams + b"\x00"
    else:
        main_streams = b""
        
    fi = b"\x05" + enc_num(len(all_items))
    if dirs:
        num_bytes = (len(all_items) + 7) // 8
        bits = bytearray(num_bytes)
        for idx, item in enumerate(all_items):
            if item[2]:
                bits[idx // 8] |= (1 << (7 - (idx % 8)))
        fi += b"\x0e" + enc_num(len(bits)) + bytes(bits)
        
    fi += b"\x19\x0c" + b"\x00" * 12
    
    utf16_names = b"\x00"
    for item in all_items:
        utf16_names += item[0].encode("utf-16le") + b"\x00\x00"
    fi += b"\x11" + enc_num(len(utf16_names)) + utf16_names + b"\x00"
    
    header = b"\x01" + main_streams + fi + b"\x00"
    
    next_ofs = len(comp_stream)
    next_sz = len(header)
    next_crc = zlib.crc32(header) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    start_hdr_data = struct.pack("<QQI", next_ofs, next_sz, next_crc)
    start_hdr_crc = zlib.crc32(start_hdr_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    sig = b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c\x00\x04"
    start_hdr = sig + struct.pack("<I", start_hdr_crc) + start_hdr_data
    
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(start_hdr)
        f.write(comp_stream)
        f.write(header)

def read_num(data, pos):
    b = data[pos]
    if (b & 0x80) == 0:
        return b, pos + 1
    count = 0
    while b & (0x80 >> count):
        count += 1
    first_byte = b & ((1 << (8 - count)) - 1)
    if count == 9:
        val = int.from_bytes(data[pos+1:pos+9], "little")
        return val, pos + 9
    val = first_byte
    for i in range(count - 1):
        val = (val << 8) + data[pos + 1 + i]
    return val, pos + count

def parse_cli(argv):
    switches = {
        "bso": 1,
        "bse": 2,
        "bsp": 1,
        "slt": False,
        "so": False,
        "si": False,
        "si_name": None,
        "sdel": False,
        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def get_archive_format(archive_name, switch_type=None):
    if switch_type:
        st = switch_type.lower()
        if "zip" in st: return "zip"
        if "tar" in st: return "tar"
        if "gz" in st or "gzip" in st: return "gzip"
        if "bz" in st or "bzip" in st: return "bzip2"
        if "xz" in st: return "xz"
        if "7z" in st: return "7z"
    if archive_name:
        ext = os.path.splitext(archive_name)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".zip", ".jar", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".epub", ".apk"): return "zip"
        if ext in (".tar", ".ova"): return "tar"
        if ext in (".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz"): return "gzip"
        if ext in (".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz"): return "bzip2"
        if ext in (".xz", ".txz"): return "xz"
        if ext in (".7z",): return "7z"
    return "7z"

def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    if len(argv) == 1 or argv[1] in ("--help", "-h", "-?", "help"):
        print_banner(1)
        sys.stdout.write(USAGE_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches = parse_cli(argv)

    if cmd == "i":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(INFO_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "b":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(BENCHMARK_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "h":
        rc = handle_hash(file_names, switches)
        sys.exit(rc)

    if cmd not in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"):
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{cmd}\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    if not archive_name:
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write("\n\nCommand Line Error:\nCannot find archive name\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    # File / Archive Operations
    fmt = get_archive_format(archive_name, switches["type"])

    if cmd == "l":
        rc = handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("e", "x"):
        rc = handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=(cmd == "x"))
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "t":
        rc = handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("a", "u"):
        rc = handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "d":
        rc = handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "rn":
        rc = handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)

# Placeholder functions
def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"] if scrc == "*" else ([scrc] if scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64") else ["CRC32"])
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    if not file_names: file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs: targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files: targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    hdr_line = ""; sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32": hdr_line += "CRC32    "; sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64": hdr_line += "CRC64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256": hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1": hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64": hdr_line += "XXH64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"; sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f: content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content); sums["CRC32"] += val; line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content); sums["CRC64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content); sums["XXH64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception: pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1: tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "

        elif h == "XXH64": val = sums["XXH64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"
    sys.stdout.write(tot_line)

    if num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]
        if h == "CRC32":
            if num_files <= 1: h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; h_str = f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X}"

    p = 0
    if length >= 32:
        p = length & ~31

    while p + 8 <= length:
        k1 = int.from_bytes(input_bytes[p:p+8], "little")
        k1 = (k1 * PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        k1 = ((k1 << 31) | (k1 >> 33)) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        k1 = (k1 * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 ^= k1
        h64 = (((h64 << 27) | (h64 >> 37)) * PRIME64_1 + PRIME64_4) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 8

    if p + 4 <= length:
        k1 = int.from_bytes(input_bytes[p:p+4], "little")
        h64 ^= (k1 * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 = (((h64 << 23) | (h64 >> 41)) * PRIME64_2 + PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 4

    while p < length:
        k1 = input_bytes[p]
        h64 ^= (k1 * PRIME64_5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 = (((h64 << 11) | (h64 >> 53)) * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 1

    h64 ^= h64 >> 33
    h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    h64 ^= h64 >> 29
    h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    h64 ^= h64 >> 32
    return h64

def sha1_func(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()

def sha256_func(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

# ==============================================================================
# 7Z ENCODER / PARSER
# ==============================================================================

def enc_num(n):
    if n < 0x80:
        return bytes([n])
    elif n < 0x4000:
        return bytes([0x80 | (n >> 8), n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x200000:
        return bytes([0xC0 | (n >> 16), (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x10000000:
        return bytes([0xE0 | (n >> 24), (n >> 16) & 0xFF, (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    else:
        return bytes([0xFF]) + struct.pack("<Q", n)

def create_7z(filename, files_list):
    dirs = [f for f in files_list if f[2]]
    files = [f for f in files_list if not f[2]]
    all_items = dirs + files
    
    data_bytes = b"".join(f[1] for f in files)
    
    if data_bytes:
        c = lzma.LZMACompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2, "dict_size": 1 << 20}])
        comp_stream = c.compress(data_bytes) + c.flush()
    else:
        comp_stream = b""
        
    pack_info = b"\x06\x00\x01\x09" + enc_num(len(comp_stream)) + b"\x00" if comp_stream else b""
    
    if files:
        unpack_info = b"\x07\x0b\x01\x00\x01\x21\x21\x01\x00\x0c" + enc_num(len(data_bytes)) + b"\x00"
        if len(files) > 1:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0d" + enc_num(len(files)) + b"\x09"
            for f in files[:-1]:
                sub_streams += enc_num(len(f[1]))
            sub_streams += b"\x0a\x01"
            for f in files:
                sub_streams += struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(f[1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
            sub_streams += b"\x00"
        else:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0a\x01" + struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(files[0][1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF) + b"\x00"
        main_streams = b"\x04" + pack_info + unpack_info + sub_streams + b"\x00"
    else:
        main_streams = b""
        
    fi = b"\x05" + enc_num(len(all_items))
    if dirs:
        num_bytes = (len(all_items) + 7) // 8
        bits = bytearray(num_bytes)
        for idx, item in enumerate(all_items):
            if item[2]:
                bits[idx // 8] |= (1 << (7 - (idx % 8)))
        fi += b"\x0e" + enc_num(len(bits)) + bytes(bits)
        
    fi += b"\x19\x0c" + b"\x00" * 12
    
    utf16_names = b"\x00"
    for item in all_items:
        utf16_names += item[0].encode("utf-16le") + b"\x00\x00"
    fi += b"\x11" + enc_num(len(utf16_names)) + utf16_names + b"\x00"
    
    header = b"\x01" + main_streams + fi + b"\x00"
    
    next_ofs = len(comp_stream)
    next_sz = len(header)
    next_crc = zlib.crc32(header) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    start_hdr_data = struct.pack("<QQI", next_ofs, next_sz, next_crc)
    start_hdr_crc = zlib.crc32(start_hdr_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    sig = b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c\x00\x04"
    start_hdr = sig + struct.pack("<I", start_hdr_crc) + start_hdr_data
    
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(start_hdr)
        f.write(comp_stream)
        f.write(header)

def read_num(data, pos):
    b = data[pos]
    if (b & 0x80) == 0:
        return b, pos + 1
    count = 0
    while b & (0x80 >> count):
        count += 1
    first_byte = b & ((1 << (8 - count)) - 1)
    if count == 9:
        val = int.from_bytes(data[pos+1:pos+9], "little")
        return val, pos + 9
    val = first_byte
    for i in range(count - 1):
        val = (val << 8) + data[pos + 1 + i]
    return val, pos + count

def parse_cli(argv):
    switches = {
        "bso": 1,
        "bse": 2,
        "bsp": 1,
        "slt": False,
        "so": False,
        "si": False,
        "si_name": None,
        "sdel": False,
        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def get_archive_format(archive_name, switch_type=None):
    if switch_type:
        st = switch_type.lower()
        if "zip" in st: return "zip"
        if "tar" in st: return "tar"
        if "gz" in st or "gzip" in st: return "gzip"
        if "bz" in st or "bzip" in st: return "bzip2"
        if "xz" in st: return "xz"
        if "7z" in st: return "7z"
    if archive_name:
        ext = os.path.splitext(archive_name)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".zip", ".jar", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".epub", ".apk"): return "zip"
        if ext in (".tar", ".ova"): return "tar"
        if ext in (".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz"): return "gzip"
        if ext in (".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz"): return "bzip2"
        if ext in (".xz", ".txz"): return "xz"
        if ext in (".7z",): return "7z"
    return "7z"

def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    if len(argv) == 1 or argv[1] in ("--help", "-h", "-?", "help"):
        print_banner(1)
        sys.stdout.write(USAGE_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches = parse_cli(argv)

    if cmd == "i":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(INFO_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "b":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(BENCHMARK_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "h":
        rc = handle_hash(file_names, switches)
        sys.exit(rc)

    if cmd not in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"):
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{cmd}\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    if not archive_name:
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write("\n\nCommand Line Error:\nCannot find archive name\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    # File / Archive Operations
    fmt = get_archive_format(archive_name, switches["type"])

    if cmd == "l":
        rc = handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("e", "x"):
        rc = handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=(cmd == "x"))
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "t":
        rc = handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("a", "u"):
        rc = handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "d":
        rc = handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "rn":
        rc = handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)

# Placeholder functions
def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"] if scrc == "*" else ([scrc] if scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64") else ["CRC32"])
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    if not file_names: file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs: targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files: targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    hdr_line = ""; sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32": hdr_line += "CRC32    "; sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64": hdr_line += "CRC64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256": hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1": hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64": hdr_line += "XXH64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"; sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f: content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content); sums["CRC32"] += val; line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content); sums["CRC64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content); sums["XXH64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception: pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1: tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "
        elif h == "CRC64": val = sums["CRC64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
        elif h == "SHA256": tot_line += " " * 65
        elif h == "SHA1": tot_line += " " * 41
        elif h == "XXH64": val = sums["XXH64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"

    if num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]

            if num_files <= 1: h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"

def handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):

        h64 ^= (k1 * PRIME64_5) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        h64 = (((h64 << 11) | (h64 >> 53)) * PRIME64_1) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
        p += 1

    h64 ^= h64 >> 33
    h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_2) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    h64 ^= h64 >> 29
    h64 = (h64 * PRIME64_3) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
    h64 ^= h64 >> 32
    return h64

def sha1_func(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(data).hexdigest()

def sha256_func(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

# ==============================================================================
# 7Z ENCODER / PARSER
# ==============================================================================

def enc_num(n):
    if n < 0x80:
        return bytes([n])
    elif n < 0x4000:
        return bytes([0x80 | (n >> 8), n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x200000:
        return bytes([0xC0 | (n >> 16), (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x10000000:
        return bytes([0xE0 | (n >> 24), (n >> 16) & 0xFF, (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    else:
        return bytes([0xFF]) + struct.pack("<Q", n)

def create_7z(filename, files_list):
    dirs = [f for f in files_list if f[2]]
    files = [f for f in files_list if not f[2]]
    all_items = dirs + files
    
    data_bytes = b"".join(f[1] for f in files)
    
    if data_bytes:
        c = lzma.LZMACompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2, "dict_size": 1 << 20}])
        comp_stream = c.compress(data_bytes) + c.flush()
    else:
        comp_stream = b""
        
    pack_info = b"\x06\x00\x01\x09" + enc_num(len(comp_stream)) + b"\x00" if comp_stream else b""
    
    if files:
        unpack_info = b"\x07\x0b\x01\x00\x01\x21\x21\x01\x00\x0c" + enc_num(len(data_bytes)) + b"\x00"
        if len(files) > 1:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0d" + enc_num(len(files)) + b"\x09"
            for f in files[:-1]:
                sub_streams += enc_num(len(f[1]))
            sub_streams += b"\x0a\x01"
            for f in files:
                sub_streams += struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(f[1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
            sub_streams += b"\x00"
        else:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0a\x01" + struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(files[0][1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF) + b"\x00"
        main_streams = b"\x04" + pack_info + unpack_info + sub_streams + b"\x00"
    else:
        main_streams = b""
        
    fi = b"\x05" + enc_num(len(all_items))
    if dirs:
        num_bytes = (len(all_items) + 7) // 8
        bits = bytearray(num_bytes)
        for idx, item in enumerate(all_items):
            if item[2]:
                bits[idx // 8] |= (1 << (7 - (idx % 8)))
        fi += b"\x0e" + enc_num(len(bits)) + bytes(bits)
        
    fi += b"\x19\x0c" + b"\x00" * 12
    
    utf16_names = b"\x00"
    for item in all_items:
        utf16_names += item[0].encode("utf-16le") + b"\x00\x00"
    fi += b"\x11" + enc_num(len(utf16_names)) + utf16_names + b"\x00"
    
    header = b"\x01" + main_streams + fi + b"\x00"
    
    next_ofs = len(comp_stream)
    next_sz = len(header)
    next_crc = zlib.crc32(header) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    start_hdr_data = struct.pack("<QQI", next_ofs, next_sz, next_crc)
    start_hdr_crc = zlib.crc32(start_hdr_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    sig = b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c\x00\x04"
    start_hdr = sig + struct.pack("<I", start_hdr_crc) + start_hdr_data
    
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(start_hdr)
        f.write(comp_stream)
        f.write(header)

def read_num(data, pos):
    b = data[pos]
    if (b & 0x80) == 0:
        return b, pos + 1
    count = 0
    while b & (0x80 >> count):
        count += 1
    first_byte = b & ((1 << (8 - count)) - 1)
    if count == 9:
        val = int.from_bytes(data[pos+1:pos+9], "little")
        return val, pos + 9
    val = first_byte
    for i in range(count - 1):
        val = (val << 8) + data[pos + 1 + i]
    return val, pos + count

def parse_cli(argv):
    switches = {
        "bso": 1,
        "bse": 2,
        "bsp": 1,
        "slt": False,
        "so": False,
        "si": False,
        "si_name": None,
        "sdel": False,
        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def get_archive_format(archive_name, switch_type=None):
    if switch_type:
        st = switch_type.lower()
        if "zip" in st: return "zip"
        if "tar" in st: return "tar"
        if "gz" in st or "gzip" in st: return "gzip"
        if "bz" in st or "bzip" in st: return "bzip2"
        if "xz" in st: return "xz"
        if "7z" in st: return "7z"
    if archive_name:
        ext = os.path.splitext(archive_name)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".zip", ".jar", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".epub", ".apk"): return "zip"
        if ext in (".tar", ".ova"): return "tar"
        if ext in (".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz"): return "gzip"
        if ext in (".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz"): return "bzip2"
        if ext in (".xz", ".txz"): return "xz"
        if ext in (".7z",): return "7z"
    return "7z"
