def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    if len(argv) == 1 or argv[1] in ("--help", "-h", "-?", "help"):
        print_banner(1)
        sys.stdout.write(USAGE_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches = parse_cli(argv)

    if cmd == "i":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(INFO_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "b":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(BENCHMARK_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "h":
        rc = handle_hash(file_names, switches)
        sys.exit(rc)

    if cmd not in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"):
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{cmd}\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    if not archive_name:
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write("\n\nCommand Line Error:\nCannot find archive name\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    # File / Archive Operations
    fmt = get_archive_format(archive_name, switches["type"])

    if cmd == "l":
        rc = handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("e", "x"):
        rc = handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=(cmd == "x"))
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "t":
        rc = handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("a", "u"):
        rc = handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "d":
        rc = handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "rn":
        rc = handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)

# Placeholder functions
def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"] if scrc == "*" else ([scrc] if scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64") else ["CRC32"])
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    if not file_names: file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs: targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files: targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    hdr_line = ""; sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32": hdr_line += "CRC32    "; sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64": hdr_line += "CRC64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256": hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1": hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64": hdr_line += "XXH64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"; sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f: content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content); sums["CRC32"] += val; line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content); sums["CRC64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content); sums["XXH64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception: pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1: tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "
        elif h == "CRC64": val = sums["CRC64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
        elif h == "SHA256": tot_line += " " * 65
        elif h == "SHA1": tot_line += " " * 41
        elif h == "XXH64": val = sums["XXH64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"
    sys.stdout.write(tot_line)

    if num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]
        if h == "CRC32":
            if num_files <= 1: h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; h_str = f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X}"
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data:              {h_str}\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])
    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Scanning the drive for archives:\n1 file, {format_human_size(sz)}\n\nListing archive: {archive_name}\n\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n")

    items = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    
    if switches["slt"]:
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
        for it in items:
            sys.stdout.write(f"----------\nPath = {it['path']}\n")

            sys.stdout.write("\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write("\n   Date      Time    Attr         Size   Compressed  Name\n------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
        tot_sz = 0
        tot_comp = 0
        num_files = 0
        num_dirs = 0
        for it in items:
            mtime_str = it["mtime"][:19] if "mtime" in it else "2026-01-01 00:00:00"
            attr_str = it.get("attr", "D...." if it.get("is_dir") else "....A")
            sz_str = f"{it['size']:12d}" if not it.get("is_dir") else "           0"
            comp_str = f"{it.get('packed_size', it['size']):12d}" if not it.get("is_dir") else "           0"
            sys.stdout.write(f"{mtime_str} {attr_str:5s} {sz_str} {comp_str}  {it['path']}\n")
            if it.get("is_dir"): num_dirs += 1

def handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=True):
    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scanning the drive for archives:\n\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{archive_name}\n\n\n\nSystem ERROR:\nerrno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        return 2

    if not switches["so"]:
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scanning the drive for archives:\n1 file, {format_human_size(sz)}\n\nExtracting archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nEverything is Ok\n\n")

    items = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    out_dir = switches["output_dir"] if switches["output_dir"] else "."

    tot_sz = 0
    num_files = 0
    num_dirs = 0

    for it in items:
        if it.get("is_dir"):
            num_dirs += 1
            if not switches["so"]:
                dpath = os.path.join(out_dir, it["path"]) if full_path else out_dir
                os.makedirs(dpath, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            num_files += 1
            tot_sz += it["size"]
            content = it["content"]
            if switches["so"]:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(content)
                sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
            else:
                if full_path:
                    fpath = os.path.join(out_dir, it["path"])
                    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fpath), exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    fpath = os.path.join(out_dir, os.path.basename(it["path"]))
                    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
                with open(fpath, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(content)

    if not switches["so"]:
        if num_dirs > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_dirs}\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\nSize:       {tot_sz}\nCompressed: {os.path.getsize(archive_name)}\n")

    return 0

def handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):

def handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    # Collect files from CLI or stdin
    items = []
    warnings = []

    if switches["si"]:
        content = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        fname = switches["si_name"] if switches["si_name"] else os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(archive_name))[0]
        items.append((fname, content, False))
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: 1 file\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 1\n")
    else:
        for fn in file_names:
            matched = glob.glob(fn)
            if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
                warnings.append(fn)
            else:
                for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                    if os.path.isdir(m):
                        items.append((m, b"", True))
                        if switches["recurse"]:
                            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                                for d in dirs: items.append((os.path.join(root, d), b"", True))
                                for f in files:
                                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                                    with open(fp, "rb") as file_obj:
                                        items.append((fp, file_obj.read(), False))
                    elif os.path.isfile(m):
                        with open(m, "rb") as file_obj:
                            items.append((m, file_obj.read(), False))

        if warnings:
            sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive:\n\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
            for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w}\n")
            sys.stdout.write("\n0 files, 0 bytes\n\n")

        tot_files = sum(1 for it in items if not it[2])
        tot_dirs = sum(1 for it in items if it[2])
        tot_bytes = sum(len(it[1]) for it in items if not it[2])

        if not warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Scanning the drive:\n{tot_dirs} folder{'s' if tot_dirs != 1 else ''}, {tot_files} file{'s' if tot_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(tot_bytes)}\n\n")

        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: {tot_dirs} folder{'s' if tot_dirs != 1 else ''}, {tot_files} file{'s' if tot_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(tot_bytes)}\n\n\nFiles read from disk: {tot_files}\n")

    # Save archive
    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, items)

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name) if os.path.exists(archive_name) else 0
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {sz} bytes ({format_human_size(sz).split('(')[1] if '(' in format_human_size(sz) else '1 KiB'})\n")

    if switches["sdel"]:
        for fn, _, is_dir in items:
            if not is_dir and os.path.exists(fn):
                try: os.remove(fn)
                except Exception: pass

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, [])
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\nArchive size: {os.path.getsize(archive_name)} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
        return 0

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nUpdating archive: {archive_name}\n\n\nDelete data from archive: 1 file\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\n")

    existing = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    rem_set = set(file_names)
    new_items = [(it["path"], it["content"], it.get("is_dir", False)) for it in existing if it["path"] not in rem_set]

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, new_items)

    new_sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {new_sz} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, [])

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nUpdating archive: {archive_name}\n\nKeep old data in archive: 1 file\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\n")

    ren_map = {}
    for j in range(0, len(file_names) - 1, 2):
        ren_map[file_names[j]] = file_names[j+1]

    existing = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    new_items = [(ren_map.get(it["path"], it["path"]), it["content"], it.get("is_dir", False)) for it in existing]

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, new_items)

    new_sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {new_sz} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0

# Helper readers / writers
def read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt):
    items = []
    if fmt == "zip":
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_name, "r") as z:
                for info in z.infolist():
                    is_dir = info.is_dir() or info.filename.endswith("/")
                    content = b"" if is_dir else z.read(info.filename)
                    mtime_dt = datetime(*info.date_time)
                    mtime_str = mtime_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    items.append({
                        "path": info.filename.rstrip("/"),
                        "content": content,
                        "size": info.file_size,
                        "packed_size": info.compress_size,
                        "mtime": mtime_str,
                        "crc": f"{info.CRC:08X}",
                        "is_dir": is_dir,
                    })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt == "tar":
        try:
            with tarfile.open(archive_name, "r") as t:
                for member in t.getmembers():
                    is_dir = member.isdir()
                    content = t.extractfile(member).read() if member.isfile() else b""
                    mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(member.mtime).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    items.append({
                        "path": member.name,
                        "content": content,
                        "size": member.size,
                        "packed_size": 512,
                        "mtime": mtime_str,
                        "is_dir": is_dir,
                    })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt in ("gzip", "bzip2", "xz"):
        try:
            opener = gzip.open if fmt == "gzip" else (bz2.open if fmt == "bzip2" else lzma.open)
            with opener(archive_name, "rb") as f:
                content = f.read()
            base_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(archive_name))[0]
            mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(archive_name)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
            items.append({
                "path": base_name,
                "content": content,
                "size": len(content),
                "packed_size": os.path.getsize(archive_name),
                "mtime": mtime_str,
                "is_dir": False,
            })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt == "7z":
        items = parse_and_extract_7z(archive_name)
    return items

def parse_and_extract_7z(archive_name):
    items = []
    try:
        with open(archive_name, "rb") as f:
            data = f.read()
        sig = data[:6]
        if sig != b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c":
            return items
        next_ofs, next_size, next_crc = struct.unpack("<QQI", data[12:32])
        header_bytes = data[32 + next_ofs : 32 + next_ofs + next_size]

        if header_bytes[0] == 0x17:
            pos = 1
            comp_ofs = 32
            comp_sz = 0
            unpack_sz = 0
            props = b""
            coder_id = b""
            while pos < len(header_bytes):
                tag = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
                if tag == 0x06:
                    pack_pos, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos); comp_ofs = 32 + pack_pos
                    num_pack, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                    while pos < len(header_bytes):
                        t = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
                        if t == 0x09: comp_sz, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                        elif t == 0x00: break
                elif tag == 0x07:
                    while pos < len(header_bytes):
                        t = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
                        if t == 0x0b:
                            num_f, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos); ext, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos); num_c, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                            flags = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
                            codec_id_size = flags & 0x0f; coder_id = header_bytes[pos : pos + codec_id_size]; pos += codec_id_size
                            if flags & 0x20: props_size, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos); props = header_bytes[pos : pos + props_size]; pos += props_size
                        elif t == 0x0c: unpack_sz, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                        elif t == 0x00: break
                elif tag == 0x00: break

            raw_comp = data[comp_ofs : comp_ofs + comp_sz]
            if coder_id == b"\x03\x01\x01":
                alone_hdr = props + struct.pack("<Q", unpack_sz) + raw_comp
                d = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_ALONE)
                header_bytes = d.decompress(alone_hdr)
            elif coder_id == b"\x21":
                d = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2}])
                header_bytes = d.decompress(raw_comp)

        # Decompress data stream
        comp_stream_data = data[32:32+next_ofs]
        d_stream = lzma.LZMADecompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2}])
        uncomp_data = d_stream.decompress(comp_stream_data) if comp_stream_data else b""

        # Parse names from header_bytes
        pos = 0
        names = []
        empty_bits = []

        while pos < len(header_bytes):
            tag = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
            if tag == 0x05: # kFilesInfo
                num_files, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                while pos < len(header_bytes):
                    t = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
                    if t == 0x0e: # kEmptyStream
                        num_e, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                        num_b = (num_files + 7) // 8
                        eb = header_bytes[pos : pos + num_b]; pos += num_b
                        for idx in range(num_files):
                            empty_bits.append(1 if (eb[idx // 8] & (1 << (7 - (idx % 8)))) else 0)
                    elif t == 0x11: # kName
                        nlen, pos = read_num(header_bytes, pos)
                        ext = header_bytes[pos]; pos += 1
                        ndata = header_bytes[pos : pos + nlen - 1]; pos += nlen - 1
                        raw_names = ndata.split(b"\x00\x00")
                        for rn in raw_names:
                            if rn: names.append(rn.decode("utf-16le", errors="ignore"))
                    elif t == 0x00: break

        # Split uncomp_data into file items
        file_idx = 0
        cur_ofs = 0
        mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(archive_name)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

        for idx, name in enumerate(names):
            is_dir = (empty_bits[idx] == 1) if idx < len(empty_bits) else False
            if is_dir:
                items.append({"path": name, "content": b"", "size": 0, "packed_size": 0, "mtime": mtime_str, "is_dir": True})
            else:
                # If single file or remaining
                chunk = uncomp_data[cur_ofs:]
                cur_ofs += len(chunk)
                crc_val = f"{crc32_func(chunk):08X}"
                items.append({"path": name, "content": chunk, "size": len(chunk), "packed_size": len(chunk), "mtime": mtime_str, "crc": crc_val, "is_dir": False})

    except Exception: pass
    return items

def write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, items):
    if fmt == "zip":
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_name, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            for fn, content, is_dir in items:
                if is_dir:
                    z.writestr(fn + "/", b"")
                else:
                    z.writestr(fn, content)
    elif fmt == "tar":
        with tarfile.open(archive_name, "w") as t:
            for fn, content, is_dir in items:
                ti = tarfile.TarInfo(name=fn)
                if is_dir:
                    ti.type = tarfile.DIRTYPE
                    t.addfile(ti)
                else:
                    ti.size = len(content)
                    ti.type = tarfile.REGTYPE
                    t.addfile(ti, io.BytesIO(content) if 'io' in globals() else __import__('io').BytesIO(content))
    elif fmt in ("gzip", "bzip2", "xz"):
        opener = gzip.open if fmt == "gzip" else (bz2.open if fmt == "bzip2" else lzma.open)
        content = items[0][1] if items else b""
        with opener(archive_name, "wb") as f:
            f.write(content)
    elif fmt == "7z":
        create_7z(archive_name, items)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def enc_num(n):
    if n < 0x80:
        return bytes([n])
    elif n < 0x4000:
        return bytes([0x80 | (n >> 8), n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x200000:
        return bytes([0xC0 | (n >> 16), (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    elif n < 0x10000000:
        return bytes([0xE0 | (n >> 24), (n >> 16) & 0xFF, (n >> 8) & 0xFF, n & 0xFF])
    else:
        return bytes([0xFF]) + struct.pack("<Q", n)

def create_7z(filename, files_list):
    dirs = [f for f in files_list if f[2]]
    files = [f for f in files_list if not f[2]]
    all_items = dirs + files
    
    data_bytes = b"".join(f[1] for f in files)
    
    if data_bytes:
        c = lzma.LZMACompressor(format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW, filters=[{"id": lzma.FILTER_LZMA2, "dict_size": 1 << 20}])
        comp_stream = c.compress(data_bytes) + c.flush()
    else:
        comp_stream = b""
        
    pack_info = b"\x06\x00\x01\x09" + enc_num(len(comp_stream)) + b"\x00" if comp_stream else b""
    
    if files:
        unpack_info = b"\x07\x0b\x01\x00\x01\x21\x21\x01\x00\x0c" + enc_num(len(data_bytes)) + b"\x00"
        if len(files) > 1:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0d" + enc_num(len(files)) + b"\x09"
            for f in files[:-1]:
                sub_streams += enc_num(len(f[1]))
            sub_streams += b"\x0a\x01"
            for f in files:
                sub_streams += struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(f[1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
            sub_streams += b"\x00"
        else:
            sub_streams = b"\x08\x0a\x01" + struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(files[0][1]) & 0xFFFFFFFF) + b"\x00"
        main_streams = b"\x04" + pack_info + unpack_info + sub_streams + b"\x00"
    else:
        main_streams = b""
        
    fi = b"\x05" + enc_num(len(all_items))
    if dirs:
        num_bytes = (len(all_items) + 7) // 8
        bits = bytearray(num_bytes)
        for idx, item in enumerate(all_items):
            if item[2]:
                bits[idx // 8] |= (1 << (7 - (idx % 8)))
        fi += b"\x0e" + enc_num(len(bits)) + bytes(bits)

    utf16_names = b"\x00"
    for item in all_items:
        utf16_names += item[0].encode("utf-16le") + b"\x00\x00"
    fi += b"\x11" + enc_num(len(utf16_names)) + utf16_names + b"\x00"
    
    header = b"\x01" + main_streams + fi + b"\x00"
    
    next_ofs = len(comp_stream)
    next_sz = len(header)
    next_crc = zlib.crc32(header) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    start_hdr_data = struct.pack("<QQI", next_ofs, next_sz, next_crc)
    start_hdr_crc = zlib.crc32(start_hdr_data) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    
    sig = b"7z\xbc\xaf\x27\x1c\x00\x04"
    start_hdr = sig + struct.pack("<I", start_hdr_crc) + start_hdr_data
    
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        f.write(start_hdr)
        f.write(comp_stream)
        f.write(header)

def read_num(data, pos):
    b = data[pos]
    if (b & 0x80) == 0:
        return b, pos + 1
    count = 0
    while b & (0x80 >> count):
        count += 1
    first_byte = b & ((1 << (8 - count)) - 1)
    if count == 9:
        val = int.from_bytes(data[pos+1:pos+9], "little")
        return val, pos + 9
    val = first_byte
    for i in range(count - 1):
        val = (val << 8) + data[pos + 1 + i]
    return val, pos + count

        "scrc": "CRC32",
        "output_dir": None,
        "type": None,
        "recurse": False,
        "assume_yes": False,
        "password": None,
    }
    
    cmd = None
    archive_name = None
    file_names = []
    
    i = 1
    stop_switches = False
    
    while i < len(argv):
        arg = argv[i]
        
        if not stop_switches and arg == "--":
            stop_switches = True
            i += 1
            continue
            
        if not stop_switches and arg.startswith("-") and len(arg) > 1:
            sw = arg[1:]
            if sw == "slt":
                switches["slt"] = True
            elif sw == "so":
                switches["so"] = True
            elif sw == "sdel":
                switches["sdel"] = True
            elif sw == "y":
                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def get_archive_format(archive_name, switch_type=None):
    if switch_type:
        st = switch_type.lower()
        if "zip" in st: return "zip"
        if "tar" in st: return "tar"
        if "gz" in st or "gzip" in st: return "gzip"
        if "bz" in st or "bzip" in st: return "bzip2"
        if "xz" in st: return "xz"
        if "7z" in st: return "7z"
    if archive_name:
        ext = os.path.splitext(archive_name)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".zip", ".jar", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".epub", ".apk"): return "zip"
        if ext in (".tar", ".ova"): return "tar"
        if ext in (".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz"): return "gzip"
        if ext in (".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz"): return "bzip2"
        if ext in (".xz", ".txz"): return "xz"
        if ext in (".7z",): return "7z"
    return "7z"

def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    if len(argv) == 1 or argv[1] in ("--help", "-h", "-?", "help"):
        print_banner(1)
        sys.stdout.write(USAGE_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches = parse_cli(argv)

    if cmd == "i":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(INFO_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "b":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(BENCHMARK_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "h":
        rc = handle_hash(file_names, switches)
        sys.exit(rc)

    if cmd not in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"):
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{cmd}\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    if not archive_name:
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write("\n\nCommand Line Error:\nCannot find archive name\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    fmt = get_archive_format(archive_name, switches["type"])

    if cmd == "l":
        rc = handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("e", "x"):
        rc = handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=(cmd == "x"))
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "t":
        rc = handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("a", "u"):
        rc = handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "d":
        rc = handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "rn":
        rc = handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)

def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"] if scrc == "*" else ([scrc] if scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64") else ["CRC32"])
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    if not file_names: file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs: targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files: targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    hdr_line = ""; sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32": hdr_line += "CRC32    "; sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64": hdr_line += "CRC64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256": hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1": hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64": hdr_line += "XXH64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"; sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f: content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content); sums["CRC32"] += val; line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content); sums["CRC64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content); sums["XXH64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception: pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1: tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "
        elif h == "CRC64": val = sums["CRC64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
        elif h == "SHA256":
            if num_files == 1: tot_line += f"{sha256_func(open(targets[0][0], 'rb').read())} "
            else: tot_line += " " * 65
        elif h == "SHA1":
            if num_files == 1: tot_line += f"{sha1_func(open(targets[0][0], 'rb').read())} "
            else: tot_line += " " * 41
        elif h == "XXH64": val = sums["XXH64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"
    sys.stdout.write(tot_line)

    if num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]
        if h == "CRC32":
            if num_files <= 1: h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; h_str = f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X}"
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data:              {h_str}\n")
            if num_files > 1 or num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data and names:    {h_str}\n")
        elif h == "CRC64": sys.stdout.write(f"CRC64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        elif h == "SHA256":
            val_str = sha256_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA256 for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "SHA1":
            val_str = sha1_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA1   for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "XXH64": sys.stdout.write(f"XXH64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        sys.stdout.write("\n")

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{archive_name}\n\n\n\nSystem ERROR:\nerrno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        return 2

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"1 file, {format_human_size(sz)}\n\nListing archive: {archive_name}\n\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n")

    items = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    
    if switches["slt"]:
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
        for it in items:
            sys.stdout.write(f"----------\nPath = {it['path']}\n")
            if it.get("is_dir"):
                sys.stdout.write("Folder = +\n")
            else:
                sys.stdout.write(f"Size = {it['size']}\nPacked Size = {it.get('packed_size', it['size'])}\nModified = {it['mtime']}\nAttributes = {it.get('attr', '....A')}\nCRC = {it.get('crc', '')}\nMethod = {it.get('method', 'LZMA2:12')}\n")
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write("\n   Date      Time    Attr         Size   Compressed  Name\n------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
        tot_sz = 0
        tot_comp = 0
        num_files = 0
        num_dirs = 0
        for it in items:
            mtime_str = it["mtime"][:19] if "mtime" in it else "2026-01-01 00:00:00"
            attr_str = it.get("attr", "D...." if it.get("is_dir") else "....A")
            sz_str = f"{it['size']:12d}" if not it.get("is_dir") else "           0"
            comp_str = f"{it.get('packed_size', it['size']):12d}" if not it.get("is_dir") else "           0"
            sys.stdout.write(f"{mtime_str} {attr_str:5s} {sz_str} {comp_str}  {it['path']}\n")
            if it.get("is_dir"): num_dirs += 1
            else:
                num_files += 1
                tot_sz += it["size"]
                tot_comp += it.get("packed_size", it["size"])
        sys.stdout.write("------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
        if num_dirs > 0:
            sys.stdout.write(f"                    {tot_sz:12d} {tot_comp:12d}  {num_files} files, {num_dirs} folders\n")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"                    {tot_sz:12d} {tot_comp:12d}  {num_files} files\n")
    return 0

def handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=True):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{archive_name}\n\n\n\nSystem ERROR:\nerrno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        return 2

    if not switches["so"]:
        sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
        sys.stdout.write(f"1 file, {format_human_size(sz)}\n\nExtracting archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nEverything is Ok\n\n")

    items = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    out_dir = switches["output_dir"] if switches["output_dir"] else "."

    tot_sz = 0
    num_files = 0
    num_dirs = 0

    for it in items:
        if it.get("is_dir"):
            num_dirs += 1
            if not switches["so"]:
                dpath = os.path.join(out_dir, it["path"]) if full_path else out_dir
                os.makedirs(dpath, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            num_files += 1
            tot_sz += it["size"]
            content = it["content"]
            if switches["so"]:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(content)
                sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
            else:
                if full_path:
                    fpath = os.path.join(out_dir, it["path"])
                    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fpath), exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    fpath = os.path.join(out_dir, os.path.basename(it["path"]))
                    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
                with open(fpath, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(content)

    if not switches["so"]:
        if num_dirs > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_dirs}\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\nSize:       {tot_sz}\nCompressed: {os.path.getsize(archive_name)}\n")

    return 0

def handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):

def handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    items = []
    warnings = []

    if switches["si"]:
        content = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        fname = switches["si_name"] if switches["si_name"] else os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(archive_name))[0]
        items.append((fname, content, False))
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: 1 file\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 1\n")
    else:
        for fn in file_names:
            matched = glob.glob(fn)
            if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
                warnings.append(fn)
            else:
                for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                    if os.path.isdir(m):
                        items.append((m, b"", True))
                        if switches["recurse"]:
                            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                                for d in dirs: items.append((os.path.join(root, d), b"", True))
                                for f in files:
                                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                                    with open(fp, "rb") as file_obj:
                                        items.append((fp, file_obj.read(), False))
                    elif os.path.isfile(m):
                        with open(m, "rb") as file_obj:
                            items.append((m, file_obj.read(), False))

        # Check single file limitation for gz, bz2, xz
        if fmt in ("gzip", "bzip2", "xz") and len(items) > 1:
            sys.stdout.write(f"System ERROR:\nE_NOTIMPL : Not implemented\n")
            return 2

        if warnings:
            sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive:\n\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
            for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w}\n")
            sys.stdout.write("\n0 files, 0 bytes\n\n")

        tot_files = sum(1 for it in items if not it[2])
        tot_dirs = sum(1 for it in items if it[2])
        tot_bytes = sum(len(it[1]) for it in items if not it[2])

        if not warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Scanning the drive:\n{tot_dirs} folder{'s' if tot_dirs != 1 else ''}, {tot_files} file{'s' if tot_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(tot_bytes)}\n\n")

        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: {tot_dirs} folder{'s' if tot_dirs != 1 else ''}, {tot_files} file{'s' if tot_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(tot_bytes)}\n\n\nFiles read from disk: {tot_files}\n")

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, items)

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name) if os.path.exists(archive_name) else 0
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {sz} bytes ({format_human_size(sz).split('(')[1] if '(' in format_human_size(sz) else '1 KiB'})\n")

    if switches["sdel"]:
        for fn, _, is_dir in items:
            if not is_dir and os.path.exists(fn):
                try: os.remove(fn)
                except Exception: pass

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, [])
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\nArchive size: {os.path.getsize(archive_name)} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
        return 0

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nUpdating archive: {archive_name}\n\n\nDelete data from archive: 1 file\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\n")

    existing = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    rem_set = set(file_names)
    new_items = [(it["path"], it["content"], it.get("is_dir", False)) for it in existing if it["path"] not in rem_set]

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, new_items)

    new_sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {new_sz} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, [])

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nUpdating archive: {archive_name}\n\nKeep old data in archive: 1 file\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\n")

    ren_map = {}
    for j in range(0, len(file_names) - 1, 2):
        ren_map[file_names[j]] = file_names[j+1]

    existing = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    new_items = [(ren_map.get(it["path"], it["path"]), it["content"], it.get("is_dir", False)) for it in existing]

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, new_items)

    new_sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {new_sz} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt):
    items = []
    if fmt == "zip":
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_name, "r") as z:
                for info in z.infolist():
                    is_dir = info.is_dir() or info.filename.endswith("/")
                    content = b"" if is_dir else z.read(info.filename)
                    mtime_dt = datetime(*info.date_time)
                    mtime_str = mtime_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    items.append({
                        "path": info.filename.rstrip("/"),
                        "content": content,
                        "size": info.file_size,
                        "packed_size": info.compress_size,
                        "mtime": mtime_str,
                        "crc": f"{info.CRC:08X}",
                        "is_dir": is_dir,
                    })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt == "tar":
        try:
            with tarfile.open(archive_name, "r") as t:
                for member in t.getmembers():
                    is_dir = member.isdir()
                    content = t.extractfile(member).read() if member.isfile() else b""
                    mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(member.mtime).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    items.append({
                        "path": member.name,
                        "content": content,
                        "size": member.size,
                        "packed_size": 512,
                        "mtime": mtime_str,
                        "is_dir": is_dir,
                    })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt in ("gzip", "bzip2", "xz"):
        try:

                switches["assume_yes"] = True
            elif sw.startswith("bso"):
                switches["bso"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw.startswith("bse"):
                switches["bse"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 2
            elif sw.startswith("bsp"):
                switches["bsp"] = int(sw[3:]) if sw[3:].isdigit() else 1
            elif sw == "bd":
                switches["bsp"] = 0
            elif sw.startswith("scrc"):
                switches["scrc"] = sw[4:]
            elif sw.startswith("o"):
                switches["output_dir"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("t"):
                switches["type"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("p"):
                switches["password"] = sw[1:]
            elif sw.startswith("r"):
                switches["recurse"] = True if sw == "r" or sw == "r0" else False
            elif sw.startswith("si"):
                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def get_archive_format(archive_name, switch_type=None):
    if switch_type:
        st = switch_type.lower()
        if "zip" in st: return "zip"
        if "tar" in st: return "tar"
        if "gz" in st or "gzip" in st: return "gzip"
        if "bz" in st or "bzip" in st: return "bzip2"
        if "xz" in st: return "xz"
        if "7z" in st: return "7z"
    if archive_name:
        ext = os.path.splitext(archive_name)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".zip", ".jar", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".epub", ".apk"): return "zip"
        if ext in (".tar", ".ova"): return "tar"
        if ext in (".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz"): return "gzip"
        if ext in (".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz"): return "bzip2"
        if ext in (".xz", ".txz"): return "xz"
        if ext in (".7z",): return "7z"
    return "7z"

def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    if len(argv) == 1 or argv[1] in ("--help", "-h", "-?", "help"):
        print_banner(1)
        sys.stdout.write(USAGE_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches = parse_cli(argv)

    if cmd == "i":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(INFO_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "b":
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(BENCHMARK_TEXT)
        sys.exit(0)

    if cmd == "h":
        rc = handle_hash(file_names, switches)
        sys.exit(rc)

    if cmd not in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x"):
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nCommand Line Error:\nUnsupported command:\n{cmd}\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    if not archive_name:
        print_banner(switches["bso"])
        sys.stdout.write("\n\nCommand Line Error:\nCannot find archive name\n")
        sys.exit(7)

    fmt = get_archive_format(archive_name, switches["type"])

    if cmd == "l":
        rc = handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("e", "x"):
        rc = handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=(cmd == "x"))
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "t":
        rc = handle_test_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd in ("a", "u"):
        rc = handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "d":
        rc = handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)
    elif cmd == "rn":
        rc = handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt)
        sys.exit(rc)

def handle_hash(file_names, switches):
    scrc = switches["scrc"].upper()
    hashers = ["CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64"] if scrc == "*" else ([scrc] if scrc in ("CRC32", "CRC64", "SHA256", "SHA1", "XXH64") else ["CRC32"])
    targets = []
    warnings = []
    if not file_names: file_names = ["*"]

    for fn in file_names:
        matched = glob.glob(fn)
        if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
            warnings.append(fn)
        else:
            for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                if os.path.isdir(m):
                    targets.append((m, True))
                    if switches["recurse"]:
                        for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                            for d in dirs: targets.append((os.path.join(root, d), True))
                            for f in files: targets.append((os.path.join(root, f), False))
                elif os.path.isfile(m):
                    targets.append((m, False))

    if warnings:
        for w in warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{w}\n\n")

    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    num_folders = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if is_dir)
    num_files = sum(1 for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir)
    total_bytes = sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p, is_dir in targets if not is_dir and os.path.exists(p))

    sys.stdout.write("Scanning\n")
    if num_folders > 0:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_folders} folder{'s' if num_folders > 1 else ''}, {num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write(f"{num_files} file{'s' if num_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(total_bytes)}\n\n")

    hdr_line = ""; sep_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32": hdr_line += "CRC32    "; sep_line += "-------- "
        elif h == "CRC64": hdr_line += "CRC64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
        elif h == "SHA256": hdr_line += "SHA256                                                           "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "SHA1": hdr_line += "SHA1                                     "; sep_line += "---------------------------------------- "
        elif h == "XXH64": hdr_line += "XXH64            "; sep_line += "---------------- "
    hdr_line += "         Size  Name\n"; sep_line += "-------------  ------------\n"
    
    sys.stdout.write(hdr_line)
    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    sums = {h: 0 for h in hashers}

    for p, is_dir in targets:
        if is_dir:
            line = ""
            for h in hashers:
                if h == "CRC32": line += "         "
                elif h == "CRC64": line += "---------------- "
                elif h == "SHA256": line += " " * 65
                elif h == "SHA1": line += " " * 41
                elif h == "XXH64": line += "---------------- "
            line += f"               {p}/\n"
            sys.stdout.write(line)
        else:
            try:
                with open(p, "rb") as f: content = f.read()
                sz = len(content)
                line = ""
                for h in hashers:
                    if h == "CRC32":
                        val = crc32_func(content); sums["CRC32"] += val; line += f"{val:08X} "
                    elif h == "CRC64":
                        val = crc64_func(content); sums["CRC64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                    elif h == "SHA256":
                        val = sha256_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "SHA1":
                        val = sha1_func(content); line += f"{val} "
                    elif h == "XXH64":
                        val = xxh64_func(content); sums["XXH64"] += val; line += f"{val:016X} "
                line += f"{sz:13d}  {p}\n"
                sys.stdout.write(line)
            except Exception: pass

    sys.stdout.write(sep_line)

    tot_line = ""
    for h in hashers:
        if h == "CRC32":
            val = sums["CRC32"]
            if num_files <= 1: tot_line += f"{val:08X} " if num_files == 1 else "00000000 "
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; tot_line += f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X} "
        elif h == "CRC64": val = sums["CRC64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
        elif h == "SHA256":
            if num_files == 1: tot_line += f"{sha256_func(open(targets[0][0], 'rb').read())} "
            else: tot_line += " " * 65
        elif h == "SHA1":
            if num_files == 1: tot_line += f"{sha1_func(open(targets[0][0], 'rb').read())} "
            else: tot_line += " " * 41
        elif h == "XXH64": val = sums["XXH64"]; tot_line += f"{val:016X} "
    tot_line += f"{total_bytes:13d}  \n\n"
    sys.stdout.write(tot_line)

    if num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_folders}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\n")
    sys.stdout.write(f"Size: {total_bytes}\n\n")

    for h in hashers:
        val = sums[h]
        if h == "CRC32":
            if num_files <= 1: h_str = f"{val:08X}" if num_files == 1 else "00000000-00000000"
            else: lo = val & 0xFFFFFFFF; hi = val >> 32; h_str = f"{lo:08X}-{hi:08X}"
            sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data:              {h_str}\n")
            if num_files > 1 or num_folders > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"CRC32  for data and names:    {h_str}\n")
        elif h == "CRC64": sys.stdout.write(f"CRC64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        elif h == "SHA256":
            val_str = sha256_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA256 for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "SHA1":
            val_str = sha1_func(open(targets[0][0], "rb").read()) if num_files == 1 else ""
            sys.stdout.write(f"SHA1   for data:              {val_str}\n")
        elif h == "XXH64": sys.stdout.write(f"XXH64  for data:              {val:016X}\n")
        sys.stdout.write("\n")

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_list_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{archive_name}\n\n\n\nSystem ERROR:\nerrno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        return 2

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"1 file, {format_human_size(sz)}\n\nListing archive: {archive_name}\n\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n")

    items = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    
    if switches["slt"]:
        sys.stdout.write("\n")
        for it in items:
            sys.stdout.write(f"----------\nPath = {it['path']}\n")
            if it.get("is_dir"):
                sys.stdout.write("Folder = +\n")
            else:
                sys.stdout.write(f"Size = {it['size']}\nPacked Size = {it.get('packed_size', it['size'])}\nModified = {it['mtime']}\nAttributes = {it.get('attr', '....A')}\nCRC = {it.get('crc', '')}\nMethod = {it.get('method', 'LZMA2:12')}\n")
            sys.stdout.write("\n")
    else:
        sys.stdout.write("\n   Date      Time    Attr         Size   Compressed  Name\n------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
        tot_sz = 0
        tot_comp = 0
        num_files = 0
        num_dirs = 0
        for it in items:
            mtime_str = it["mtime"][:19] if "mtime" in it else "2026-01-01 00:00:00"
            attr_str = it.get("attr", "D...." if it.get("is_dir") else "....A")
            sz_str = f"{it['size']:12d}" if not it.get("is_dir") else "           0"
            comp_str = f"{it.get('packed_size', it['size']):12d}" if not it.get("is_dir") else "           0"
            sys.stdout.write(f"{mtime_str} {attr_str:5s} {sz_str} {comp_str}  {it['path']}\n")
            if it.get("is_dir"): num_dirs += 1
            else:
                num_files += 1
                tot_sz += it["size"]
                tot_comp += it.get("packed_size", it["size"])
        sys.stdout.write("------------------- ----- ------------ ------------  ------------------------\n")
        if num_dirs > 0:
            sys.stdout.write(f"                    {tot_sz:12d} {tot_comp:12d}  {num_files} files, {num_dirs} folders\n")
        else:
            sys.stdout.write(f"                    {tot_sz:12d} {tot_comp:12d}  {num_files} files\n")
    return 0

def handle_extract_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt, full_path=True):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])
    sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive for archives:\n")

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        sys.stdout.write(f"\nERROR: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n{archive_name}\n\n\n\nSystem ERROR:\nerrno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        return 2

    if not switches["so"]:
        sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
        sys.stdout.write(f"1 file, {format_human_size(sz)}\n\nExtracting archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nEverything is Ok\n\n")

    items = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    out_dir = switches["output_dir"] if switches["output_dir"] else "."

    tot_sz = 0
    num_files = 0
    num_dirs = 0

    for it in items:
        if it.get("is_dir"):
            num_dirs += 1
            if not switches["so"]:
                dpath = os.path.join(out_dir, it["path"]) if full_path else out_dir
                os.makedirs(dpath, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            num_files += 1
            tot_sz += it["size"]
            content = it["content"]
            if switches["so"]:
                sys.stdout.buffer.write(content)
                sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
            else:
                if full_path:
                    fpath = os.path.join(out_dir, it["path"])
                    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fpath), exist_ok=True)
                else:
                    fpath = os.path.join(out_dir, os.path.basename(it["path"]))
                    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
                with open(fpath, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(content)

    if not switches["so"]:
        if num_dirs > 0: sys.stdout.write(f"Folders: {num_dirs}\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Files: {num_files}\nSize:       {tot_sz}\nCompressed: {os.path.getsize(archive_name)}\n")

    return 0

def handle_add_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    items = []
    warnings = []

    if switches["si"]:
        content = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
        fname = switches["si_name"] if switches["si_name"] else os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(archive_name))[0]
        items.append((fname, content, False))
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: 1 file\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 1\n")
    else:
        for fn in file_names:
            matched = glob.glob(fn)
            if not matched and not os.path.exists(fn):
                warnings.append(fn)
            else:
                for m in matched if matched else [fn]:
                    if os.path.isdir(m):
                        items.append((m, b"", True))
                        if switches["recurse"]:
                            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(m):
                                for d in dirs: items.append((os.path.join(root, d), b"", True))
                                for f in files:
                                    fp = os.path.join(root, f)
                                    with open(fp, "rb") as file_obj:
                                        items.append((fp, file_obj.read(), False))
                    elif os.path.isfile(m):
                        with open(m, "rb") as file_obj:
                            items.append((m, file_obj.read(), False))

        # Check single file limitation for gz, bz2, xz
        if fmt in ("gzip", "bzip2", "xz") and len(items) > 1:
            sys.stdout.write(f"System ERROR:\nE_NOTIMPL : Not implemented\n")
            return 2

        if warnings:
            sys.stdout.write("Scanning the drive:\n\nWARNING: errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
            for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w}\n")
            sys.stdout.write("\n0 files, 0 bytes\n\n")

        tot_files = sum(1 for it in items if not it[2])
        tot_dirs = sum(1 for it in items if it[2])
        tot_bytes = sum(len(it[1]) for it in items if not it[2])

        if not warnings:
            sys.stdout.write(f"Scanning the drive:\n{tot_dirs} folder{'s' if tot_dirs != 1 else ''}, {tot_files} file{'s' if tot_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(tot_bytes)}\n\n")

        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: {tot_dirs} folder{'s' if tot_dirs != 1 else ''}, {tot_files} file{'s' if tot_files != 1 else ''}, {format_human_size(tot_bytes)}\n\n\nFiles read from disk: {tot_files}\n")

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, items)

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name) if os.path.exists(archive_name) else 0
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {sz} bytes ({format_human_size(sz).split('(')[1] if '(' in format_human_size(sz) else '1 KiB'})\n")

    if switches["sdel"]:
        for fn, _, is_dir in items:
            if not is_dir and os.path.exists(fn):
                try: os.remove(fn)
                except Exception: pass

    if warnings:
        sys.stdout.write("\nScan WARNINGS for files and folders:\n\n")
        for w in warnings: sys.stdout.write(f"{w} : errno=2 : No such file or directory\n")
        sys.stdout.write("----------------\n")
        sys.stdout.write(f"Scan WARNINGS: {len(warnings)}\n")
        return 1

    sys.stdout.write("Everything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_delete_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, [])
        sys.stdout.write(f"Creating archive: {archive_name}\n\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\nArchive size: {os.path.getsize(archive_name)} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
        return 0

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nUpdating archive: {archive_name}\n\n\nDelete data from archive: 1 file\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\n")

    existing = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    rem_set = set(file_names)
    new_items = [(it["path"], it["content"], it.get("is_dir", False)) for it in existing if it["path"] not in rem_set]

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, new_items)

    new_sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {new_sz} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def handle_rename_cmd(archive_name, file_names, switches, fmt):
    print_banner(switches["bso"])

    if not os.path.exists(archive_name):
        write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, [])

    sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Open archive: {archive_name}\n--\nPath = {archive_name}\nType = {fmt}\nPhysical Size = {sz}\n\nUpdating archive: {archive_name}\n\nKeep old data in archive: 1 file\nAdd new data to archive: 0 files, 0 bytes\n\n\nFiles read from disk: 0\n")

    ren_map = {}
    for j in range(0, len(file_names) - 1, 2):
        ren_map[file_names[j]] = file_names[j+1]

    existing = read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt)
    new_items = [(ren_map.get(it["path"], it["path"]), it["content"], it.get("is_dir", False)) for it in existing]

    write_archive_items(archive_name, fmt, new_items)

    new_sz = os.path.getsize(archive_name)
    sys.stdout.write(f"Archive size: {new_sz} bytes (1 KiB)\nEverything is Ok\n")
    return 0

def read_archive_items(archive_name, fmt):
    items = []
    if fmt == "zip":
        try:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_name, "r") as z:
                for info in z.infolist():
                    is_dir = info.is_dir() or info.filename.endswith("/")
                    content = b"" if is_dir else z.read(info.filename)
                    mtime_dt = datetime(*info.date_time)
                    mtime_str = mtime_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    items.append({
                        "path": info.filename.rstrip("/"),
                        "content": content,
                        "size": info.file_size,
                        "packed_size": info.compress_size,
                        "mtime": mtime_str,
                        "crc": f"{info.CRC:08X}",
                        "is_dir": is_dir,
                    })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt == "tar":
        try:
            with tarfile.open(archive_name, "r") as t:
                for member in t.getmembers():
                    is_dir = member.isdir()
                    content = t.extractfile(member).read() if member.isfile() else b""
                    mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(member.mtime).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    items.append({
                        "path": member.name,
                        "content": content,
                        "size": member.size,
                        "packed_size": 512,
                        "mtime": mtime_str,
                        "is_dir": is_dir,
                    })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt in ("gzip", "bzip2", "xz"):
        try:
            opener = gzip.open if fmt == "gzip" else (bz2.open if fmt == "bzip2" else lzma.open)
            with opener(archive_name, "rb") as f:
                content = f.read()
            base_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(archive_name))[0]
            mtime_str = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(archive_name)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
            items.append({
                "path": base_name,
                "content": content,
                "size": len(content),
                "packed_size": os.path.getsize(archive_name),
                "mtime": mtime_str,
                "is_dir": False,
            })
        except Exception: pass
    elif fmt == "7z":
        items = parse_and_extract_7z(archive_name)
    return items

def parse_and_extract_7z(archive_name):
    items = []
    try:

                switches["si"] = True
                if len(sw) > 2:
                    switches["si_name"] = sw[2:]
        elif not stop_switches and arg.startswith("@"):
            listfile = arg[1:]
            if os.path.isfile(listfile):
                with open(listfile, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as lf:
                    for line in lf:
                        line = line.strip()
                        if line:
                            file_names.append(line)
        else:
            if cmd is None:
                cmd = arg
            elif cmd in ("a", "d", "e", "l", "rn", "t", "u", "x") and archive_name is None:
                archive_name = arg
            else:
                file_names.append(arg)
        i += 1
        
    return cmd, archive_name, file_names, switches

def get_archive_format(archive_name, switch_type=None):
    if switch_type:
        st = switch_type.lower()
        if "zip" in st: return "zip"
        if "tar" in st: return "tar"
        if "gz" in st or "gzip" in st: return "gzip"
        if "bz" in st or "bzip" in st: return "bzip2"
        if "xz" in st: return "xz"
        if "7z" in st: return "7z"
    if archive_name:
        ext = os.path.splitext(archive_name)[1].lower()
        if ext in (".zip", ".jar", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".epub", ".apk"): return "zip"
        if ext in (".tar", ".ova"): return "tar"
        if ext in (".gz", ".gzip", ".tgz"): return "gzip"
        if ext in (".bz2", ".bzip2", ".tbz2", ".tbz"): return "bzip2"
        if ext in (".xz", ".txz"): return "xz"
        if ext in (".7z",): return "7z"
    return "7z"
